sentences.text:
Ramkishor Gope son of Late Munu Gope, resident of village Karakel, P.O. & P.S.- Kamdara,
District- Gumla ... ... Petitioners Versus The State of Jharkhand .... ...

Opposite Party Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar For the Petitioners : Mr. Kumar Nishant, Advocate
For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, A.P.P. Order No. 02 Dated: 12.11.2024

The petitioners a p p r e h e n d i n g t h e i r a r r e s t f o r t h e o f f e n c e s p u n i s h a b l e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 420/467/468/471/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, have prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in the present case and have not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.
The petitioner nos. 1 and 2 are the witnesses of the sale deed whereas the petitioner no. 3 is the son of the informant who sold the land in question.
It is further submitted that the petitioner no. 3 being one of the co-parceners of the ancestral property had the right to sell his proportionate share of the property.

Hence, no illegality was committed by him in selling the ancestral land measuring an area of 0.05 acre out of 0.13 acre with respect to Khata No. 42, plot no. 679 and 9.5 decimals & 04 decimals out of 60 decimals with respect to Khata No. 42, plot no. 405, Mouza- Karakel, P.S.- Kamdara, District- Gumla to different persons through separate sale deeds.
The informant (the mother of the petitioner no. 3) has lodged the present F.I.R. on the instigation of some of the villagers.

Co-accused persons namely Niranjan Sahu, Bhism Narayan Kumar and Dinesh Sahu have already been granted anticipatory bail by a Bench of this Court vide order dated 29.01.2024 passed in A.B.A. No. 9768 of 2023.
The petitioners also undertake to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, they may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.P.P. opposes the petitioners' prayer for anticipatory bail.

4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that aforesaid co-accused persons Sanjay Singh Son Of Devnarayan Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ... Opposite ... on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36564614/
1 have already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text:
5. Accordingly, the petitioners, above named, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Gumla in connection with Kamdara P.S. Case No. 21 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under 482(2) of the 'Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023'.
Ritesh/ (Rajesh Shankar, J.)
